_meta: A treated group and a control group each measured before and after a treatment that only the treated group received, used to show that the two obvious ways to estimate the treatment's effect are both biased -- comparing the treated group before versus after also captures whatever changed over time for everyone, and comparing the treated versus control group after the treatment also captures whatever difference already existed between the groups -- while difference-in-differences subtracts one bias out with the other and recovers the true effect under the parallel-trends assumption. When you cannot randomize (a policy applies to one state, a feature ships to one region), you have four numbers: the treated group's outcome before and after, and the control group's outcome before and after. The before/after difference on the treated group is (after_treated - before_treated), but part of that is a time trend that would have moved the group even without treatment. The cross-sectional difference (after_treated - after_control) is contaminated by the pre-existing gap between the groups. Difference-in-differences computes (after_treated - before_treated) - (after_control - before_control): the control group's before-to-after change estimates the common time trend, and subtracting it from the treated group's change removes it, leaving the treatment effect. This is valid only under parallel trends -- the assumption that, absent the treatment, the treated group would have changed by the same amount as the control group -- which the data cannot verify. On this fixture the true effect is 15: the treated group's counterfactual after value (its before value plus the control's time trend) is 115, and its actual after is 130. The before/after estimate is 30 (overstated by the time trend of 15), the cross-sectional estimate is 35 (overstated by the pre-existing gap of 20), and difference-in-differences is 15. The four measurements are the fixture; every naive estimate, the counterfactual, and the difference-in-differences estimate are computed. Stdlib only.
